selectionRule: All previously unreviewed head-only pairs and named sitting/seated/arms-raised posture pairs; six non-head motion pairs and eight generic body-pose pairs selected by ascending SHA256 of ASCII pf-training-expansion-v1|<original returned index>. Explicitly stratified selected-output training audit; not prevalence or overall Precision.

rubric.0: Selected actors show clearly incompatible actions/postures.
rubric.1: Weak, generic or redundant resemblance; partial similarity does not establish a useful parallel.
rubric.2: Clear comparable distinctive action or posture supported by matched-track temporal evidence.

reviewPolicy: Inspect six temporal frames per side and native selected-track overlays before assigning a grade; scores/classifier labels hidden on sheets. Track identity must be verified for numeric grades. Assistant annotation, not independent human ground truth.
independence: No held-out E03/E04 reports/labels used for sampling or fitting; no thresholds or ranker parameters will be fitted until expanded training annotations are frozen.
